paths.title: Champion of Corellon
paths.description: Fight like a dancer in plate, fusing Charisma-driven strikes with nimble footwork that few armored warriors can match. An action point lets you spend a healing surge, and good Dexterity sharpens the defense of heavy armor, while by 16th level you ignore its speed penalty and can shift when you bloody a foe. Elegant strikes slow targets, a graceful step carries you across rough ground, and a final attack can blind an enemy and empower your opportunity attacks.

paths.title: Champion of Order
paths.description: Law is your weapon, and you bring it down hardest on the demons and elementals that oppose it. Spending an action point dazzles adjacent enemies into lowered defenses, and anything that ignores your divine challenge risks an opportunity attack. Against your chosen monstrous foes you add radiant damage and, by 16th level, ignore their resistances. A true strike, a daily power that lets you challenge two enemies, and a crushing blow that weakens round it out.

paths.title: Dragonslayer
paths.description: When something enormous bears down on your allies, you step forward behind sword and shield and refuse to give ground. An action point makes you far harder to hit for creatures you have marked, and the first creature you mark each encounter takes extra damage from you. At 16th level fear loses much of its grip, while a smite amplifies your divine sanction and challenge, and a raised shield can halve a blast for you and an adjacent ally. Your daily prayer hurls a foe to the ground.

paths.title: Faithful Shield
paths.description: You exist to keep your friends standing, turning each action point and each healing touch into protection that spreads across the party. Lay on Hands grants its target stronger defenses, an action point shelters allies nearby, and a protecting smite gives everyone close to you defensive power. A shield stance reduces forced movement, allies who catch their breath or defend can punish those who strike them, and your daily burst blasts enemies back while rewarding you for holding your ground.

paths.title: Fortune Blessed
paths.description: Avandra's favor turns chance itself into a resource you can bank and spend. Natural 1s and 20s earn luck tokens, and a token spent later nudges a roll upward or lets you try it again, while an action point can win you another token through a saving throw. Misfortune's Curse turns an enemy's missed blow into a gift for you, a lucky break can blunt a hit that would have hurt badly, and your daily attack leaves a foe dazed and slowed while you force its saves to be rerolled.

paths.title: Gray Guard
paths.description: Justice is a job to finish, and you accept whatever dirty work it demands. An action point lets you shift and grants a bonus to attack rolls, while your training in Perception and Society helps you track enemies and strips marked foes of concealment. Critical hits unsettle the nearest enemy, crippling smites daze and slow targets, and a flash of relentless resolve lets you reuse an encounter attack that missed. Your daily strike can expose a foe to an ally.

paths.title: Hammer of Moradin
paths.requirements: Proficiency with warhammer or throwing hammer; must worship Moradin
paths.description: Strike for the Soul Forger with a hammer in hand, whether you serve as a cleric or a paladin. You hit more reliably with hammers, and an action point attack can knock foes prone or leave them dazed. Hurl your hammer to bash two enemies and have it return to your hand, brace yourself in a stance of stone-hard resistance, and slam a thunderous quake into the ground. Your champion's aura steels you and nearby allies against fear.

paths.title: Hospitaler
paths.description: Heal with one hand and defend with the other as you walk the front line of every fight. Your action points restore health to nearby allies, and any enemy that ignores your divine challenge in favor of an ally ends up healing that ally. By 16th level Lay on Hands is boosted by Charisma, a warding blow grants saving throws, and a prayer-charged weapon heals as you strike. Your daily attack finishes with a healing surge for an ally you choose.

paths.title: Justiciar
paths.description: You stand at the center of a circle of safety and make every adjacent ally fight harder because of it. An action point weakens the enemies around you, nearby friends can reroll saving throws, and at 16th level they also become immune to fear and charm. A radiant burst punishes enemies you have marked, a daring interrupt makes you take a hit meant for someone else, and your daily blast can force every foe in range to attend to you.

paths.title: Questing Knight
paths.description: Your conviction is a shield against deceit, despair and weakness, and you press forward with a steady, unshakable step. Spending an action point lets you make a boosted saving throw, you gain bonuses against charm, fear and illusion, and when bloodied you can take a second wind for free. A forceful blast shoves enemies away before you reposition, a daily utility cancels crippling conditions, and a fearsome blow can drive a target far back and weaken it.

paths.title: Son of Mercy
paths.description: You brand lawbreakers and make sure every blow reminds them of it. Your Lawbreaker's Doom becomes an encounter power that adds Wisdom damage and slows its target, and slaying that target grants you temporary hit points at 16th level. An action point attack can immobilize the marked foe, while a fear-laced strike can answer its attacks as an interrupt. A close burst can mark every enemy around you, and your daily strike knocks them flat.

paths.title: Vengeful Crusader
paths.description: You answer each wrong done to your allies with a swift and painful reply. Marked enemies who attack others let you shift toward them, and spending an action point while bloodied extends your divine sanction to every enemy near you. Enemies that attack allies beside you take damage at 16th level, while a driving force strike can send you charging after a target that tries to escape. A stance builds your attack bonuses as allies are hurt, and your daily attack haunts its target.
